objective: Implement an immutable deterministic Decision / Outcome Journal for P18 that records Demo/Paper decisions and later-observed outcomes with exact strategy/model/signal/risk/firewall/session lineage while preventing future-label leakage and leaving dataset curation to P18-C.
scope: Record content-addressed Demo/Paper decision journal entries
Bind decision records to P18-A session/state lineage
Preserve strategy/model/signal/risk/firewall identifiers and decision-time market evidence
Record later-observed outcome entries under an explicit versioned outcome definition
Require outcome observed time not earlier than decision time
Reject duplicate or conflicting decision/outcome identities
Maintain deterministic append-only journal ordering and journal root identity
Expose point-in-time journal views that exclude outcomes not yet observable
out_of_scope: Feature engineering or label transformation for model training
tests: Identical entries produce identical record identities
Outcome for unknown decision fails closed
Outcome observed before decision fails closed
Decision lineage fields are preserved exactly
No P18-C dataset/training authority is emitted
No broker/exchange, Live/Auto or promotion authority is emitted
P18-B evidence is byte-identical across two runs
security_tests: No future-label visibility in point-in-time view
rollback: Revert P18-B journal/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P18-A remains canonical complete and P18-C remains unstarted.
definition_of_ready: No active governed task or lock conflict
definition_of_done: Deterministic immutable Decision / Outcome Journal implemented
Decision lineage and outcome-definition version preserved
Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
